reviewContext.issueReference: workflowInput issue (no URL or number): "gmail-gateway: move to swift-crypto 5.x (retry after google-service-gateway 0.1.7)"
reviewContext.userProblem: The owner requires every Swift package in the Riela dependency graph to require and build against apple/swift-crypto 5.x (latest 5.0.3). gmail-gateway requires swift-crypto from 4.5.2 (Package.swift:20) and pins google-service-gateway 4cfef44b (Package.swift:23), which capped swift-crypto below 5 (BLK-1, now resolved by tag v0.1.7).
requiredOutcomes: Package.swift pins google-service-gateway at revision ed020e4a8f45a0acedaf46334e2a67677e3c3e63 (tag v0.1.7)
Package.resolved pins swift-crypto 5.x; gateway-sdk-kit and google-gateway-auth pins unchanged
SHA256 outputs stay byte-for-byte identical (lowercase %02x hex for fingerprint, archive sha256, attachment prefix; base64url for PKCE)
VERSION and the gmailGatewayVersion() literal become 0.1.29
embeddedVersionDoesNotDependOnAWorkingDirectoryVersionFile compares against VERSION read through a #filePath-anchored path, with no version literal
swift build, mise run test (full swift test plus smoke tests) and mise run lint pass
Finalization commits once and pushes to origin/main; the plan-archive step moves the plan and this manifest to impl-plans/completed
nonGoals: No fork, vendor, path override, mirror config or dependency removal
No pin style changes; gateway-sdk-kit stays exact 0.1.1; google-gateway-auth stays 48e0112fb5eb057cf012194cfffaa2581ba29d76; swift-tools-version stays 6.0
No refactor of the #if canImport(CryptoKit) pattern; no removal of the unused import in GmailCredentialResolution.swift; no new crypto helpers
No change to expected digest values; no deleted, skipped or weakened tests; versionFlagReturnsVersionForAllBinaries unchanged
gmailGatewayVersion() must not read VERSION at runtime; no version-generation scripts; no changeCurrentDirectoryPath in tests
No edits to design-docs/, mise.toml, Formula/, dist/, impl-plans/PROGRESS.json or other plan files
Implementer runs no git commit, push or other git write, and moves no plan files
No GitHub release, build:homebrew, homebrew:formula or homebrew:tap-formula
constraints: TASK-001 gate: refs/tags/v0.1.7 must resolve to ed020e4a8f45a0acedaf46334e2a67677e3c3e63 and its Package.swift must declare swift-crypto from 5.0.3 and google-gateway-auth 48e0112f; otherwise stop and report the exact constraint line
Use swift package update swift-crypto google-service-gateway only; never a bare swift package update
The Package.resolved diff may touch only originHash, swift-crypto, swift-asn1 and google-service-gateway
Crypto product stays linked only on Linux; macOS keeps compiling against CryptoKit
Linux scratch path stays under tmp/swift-crypto-5/build-linux (tmp/ is gitignored; .build-linux is not)
Fresh read plus pre/post sha256 for every edited file; stop on drift
All command logs go under tmp/swift-crypto-5/logs (inside evidenceRoot tmp/swift-crypto-5, untracked), with exit codes in the plan Progress Log
designDecisionsAndRationale: Pin the full tag SHA ed020e4a8f45a0acedaf46334e2a67677e3c3e63 rather than the issue's 'ed020e4f', because git ls-remote refs/tags/v0.1.7 is authoritative
google-gateway-auth stays the same because upstream google-service-gateway@ed020e4a pins the same revision, and SwiftPM requires identical revisions
The version test reads VERSION through #filePath (the lockTestDirectory idiom) so the embedded literal is checked against the real release version, independent of the working directory
Use a single serial plan, because the issue forbids a parallel plan and every verification step needs the resolved manifest
intentionalTradeoffs: The Linux build (V6) may be unavailable locally; it is logged as a verification gap backed by the swift-crypto 5.0.0 SHA256 release-note review, not counted as passing
supportedEdgeCases: A dependency caps swift-crypto below 5 during resolution: blocked stop with the exact constraint line
Upstream google-service-gateway public API changes: fixed only at GmailGatewayCore call sites with behavior unchanged, and logged
A digest call site changes in TASK-003: add a SHA256("abc") known-answer assertion in the existing feature test file
outOfScopeEdgeCases: Homebrew formula, tap or release publication

sharedPathNotes.intendedEdit: Change only the gmailGatewayVersion() literal at line 5 from "0.1.28" to "0.1.29"
Rewrite only embeddedVersionDoesNotDependOnAWorkingDirectoryVersionFile to be throws and compare gmailGatewayVersion() with nonBlank(VERSION read via a #filePath-anchored URL); no version literal
Change 0.1.28 to 0.1.29, keeping the existing byte layout

acceptanceCriteria: TASK-001 records the tag SHA ed020e4a8f45a0acedaf46334e2a67677e3c3e63, the upstream swift-crypto from 5.0.3 line, the google-gateway-auth 48e0112f line, baseline hashes, the baseline CommandTests result and the SHA256 release-note finding
Package.swift has swift-crypto from: "5.0.3" and google-service-gateway revision ed020e4a8f45a0acedaf46334e2a67677e3c3e63; lines 21 and 22 and tools-version are unchanged
Package.resolved has a swift-crypto 5.x pin; only originHash, swift-crypto, swift-asn1 and google-service-gateway entries differ
swift build exits 0 with no new swift-crypto, SHA256 or deprecation warnings from the five crypto files
No expected digest value changes; existing digest tests pass
VERSION is 0.1.29, gmailGatewayVersion() returns "0.1.29", and CommandTests contains no version literal; both version tests pass
mise run test and mise run lint exit 0; the Linux build/test passes or is logged as a verification gap

git status shows changes only in the files listed under plan V7 (which conditionally allows design-docs/specs/notes.md and impl-plans/active/swift-crypto-5-dispatch.json while still uncommitted from the design and planning steps; the implementer does not edit or move the dispatch JSON)
